From 414f65d6736342c77d4ec5e7373039f4a09250dd Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Janne Grunau <j@jannau.net>
Date: Wed, 31 Dec 2025 10:42:12 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] mfd: macsmc: Initialize mutex

Initialize struct apple_smc's mutex in apple_smc_probe(). Using the
mutex uninitialized surprisingly resulted only in occasional NULL
pointer dereferences in apple_smc_read() calls from the probe()
functions of sub devices.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: e038d985c9823 ("mfd: Add Apple Silicon System Management Controller")
Signed-off-by: Janne Grunau <j@jannau.net>
Reviewed-by: Sven Peter <sven@kernel.org>
Reviewed-by: Neal Gompa <neal@gompa.dev>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20251231-macsmc-mutex_init-v2-1-5818c9dc9b29@jannau.net
Signed-off-by: Lee Jones <lee@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/mfd/macsmc.c b/drivers/mfd/macsmc.c
index 85410f357603..1b7e7b3e785f 100644
--- a/drivers/mfd/macsmc.c
+++ b/drivers/mfd/macsmc.c
@@ -416,6 +416,7 @@ static int apple_smc_probe(struct platform_device *pdev)
 	if (!smc)
 		return -ENOMEM;
 
+	mutex_init(&smc->mutex);
 	smc->dev = &pdev->dev;
 	smc->sram_base = devm_platform_get_and_ioremap_resource(pdev, 1, &smc->sram);
 	if (IS_ERR(smc->sram_base))
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a bug in the `macsmc` driver by initializing a mutex that was previously used uninitialized, which could cause occasional NULL pointer dereferences.

## Modifications per file

- **drivers/mfd/macsmc.c**  
  Added `mutex_init(&smc->mutex);` in the `apple_smc_probe()` function, right after allocating the `smc` structure and before any operation that might use the mutex.

## Relationship between the changes

The change is a single addition in the probe function of the only modified file. It ensures that the struct `apple_smc`'s mutex is properly initialized before sub‑devices call `apple_smc_read()`, which relies on that mutex. Without this initialization, concurrent or subsequent accesses to the mutex would lead to undefined behavior, including NULL pointer dereferences.

file:<file name>

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
- In apple_smc_probe(), the initialization of the mutex is absent (the line `mutex_init(&smc->mutex);` is missing).
- In apple_smc_read(), the mutex is used without being initialized: `mutex_lock(&smc->mutex);`

Reason:
The mutex `smc->mutex` was never initialized via `mutex_init()`. When sub‑device probe functions call `apple_smc_read()`, they attempt to lock this uninitialized mutex, causing undefined behavior that manifests as occasional NULL pointer dereferences.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
- In apple_smc_probe(), the added line: `mutex_init(&smc->mutex);`

Reason:
Explicitly initializing the mutex with `mutex_init()` right after allocating the `apple_smc` structure ensures that the mutex is in a valid state before any code can lock it. This eliminates the undefined behavior and prevents the NULL pointer dereferences.
